name: naija-pay-monorepo
description: One typed interface to every Nigerian payment and banking-as-a-service provider
author: Akanji Oluwaseun Gabriel (https://github.com/asgatcreation)

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:python && npm run test:parity && npm run check:data
scripts.build: npm run build:js --workspace @asgatcreation/naija-pay && npm run build:types --workspace @asgatcreation/naija-pay
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run size && npm run smoke
scripts.sandbox: npm run sandbox:paystack && npm run sandbox:paystack:python
